decks.notes: This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy while applying pressure with efficient creatures. It utilizes cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Spirit of the Labyrinth to slow down the opponent, while also using Aether Vial to cheat creatures into play. The deck has a solid mana denial plan with cards like Wasteland and Rishadan Port, with the ability to lock down problematic permanents using Karakas. The deck also has a strong equipment package with Stoneforge Mystic fetching powerful choices like Batterskull and Umezawa's Jitte. The goal is to control the game and close it out with efficient threats.

The deck focuses on combining the powerful threat of Phyrexian Dreadnought with control elements like Stifle and Force of Will to disrupt the opponent's game plan. It includes cards like Daze and Thoughtseize to further disrupt the opponent's plays while using cards like Brainstorm and Ponder to find the needed pieces. Murktide Regent and Death's Shadow provide additional threats and pressure while the mana base is designed to support the multiple colors required for the deck's spells. Overall, the deck aims to control the game and overwhelm the opponent with efficient threats.

The deck focuses on generating mana with elves and using that mana to quickly summon and combo off powerful creatures like Craterhoof Behemoth and Regal Force. Heritage Druid, Nettle Sentinel, and Birchlore Rangers enable explosive mana generation, while cards like Glimpse of Nature and Allosaurus Shepherd help cycle through the deck and protect key cards. Natural Order and Green Sun's Zenith provide additional ways to tutor for key creatures, while Boseiju, Who Endures ensures that important spells cannot be countered. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a fast and aggressive combo strategy.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana using mana dorks like Nettle Sentinel and Birchlore Rangers, then draw a ton of cards with Glimpse of Nature and generate large amounts of mana with Gaea's Cradle. Once you have enough mana, you can use Natural Order to search for a powerful creature like Craterhoof Behemoth to overrun your opponent. The deck also has access to tutor effects like Green Sun's Zenith to find key creatures and ways to protect your combo pieces with cards like Allosaurus Shepherd.

This deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy with a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card draw. It utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Jace, the Mind Sculptor and Teferi, Time Raveler to control the board and stall the game until it can win with its own win conditions. The inclusion of cards like Hullbreacher and Narset, Parter of Veils allows the deck to punish opponents for drawing cards, while cards like Terminus provide a one-sided board wipe. The mana base is designed to support the deck's diverse color requirements.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly and efficiently get creatures, particularly Ninjas, onto the battlefield to deal damage to the opponent as quickly as possible. The deck focuses on using cheap and evasive creatures like Changeling Outcast and Ornithopter, along with powerful Ninjas like Yuriko, the Tiger's Shadow and Ingenious Infiltrator, to attack the opponent's life total. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect its creatures and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and ensure consistent access to the necessary lands.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana and cheat out powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath using cards like Show and Tell and Omniscience. By utilizing cards like Cunning Wish, Veil of Summer, and Force of Will for protection, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats without giving them a chance to respond effectively. The inclusion of cards like Endurance and Ice-Fang Coatl provide additional utility and flexibility to deal with various situations.

The main idea of this Jeskai Tempo deck is to apply pressure on the opponent quickly and efficiently with a combination of cheap spells and aggressive creatures. By using efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Prismatic Ending, disruptive counter magic like Daze and Force of Will, and powerful creatures like Delver of Secrets and Geist of Saint Traft, the deck aims to control the board while dealing damage to the opponent. The deck also includes versatile cards like Karakas and Lavinia, Azorius Renegade to disrupt the opponent's strategies and gain tempo advantage.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying threats like Delver of Secrets and Murktide Regent while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counter spells like Force of Will and Daze. The aim is to apply pressure early on and maintain tempo advantage with efficient spells like Lightning Bolt and Brazen Borrower. The mana base is centered around efficient fetching with cards like Scalding Tarn and Wasteland to ensure consistent access to the deck's powerful spells and keep the opponent on the back foot.

The key concept of the deck is to maintain tempo and pressure on the opponent by using efficient creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Murktide Regent, backed up by disruptive spells like Daze and Force of Will. The deck aims to control the board early with cards like Delver of Secrets and Brazen Borrower, while also having the flexibility to protect its threats with countermagic. The land base is designed to support the aggressive game plan, with a focus on mana efficiency and disruption through cards like Wasteland. Overall, the deck aims to curve out smoothly and overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize.

The main concept of this deck is to play aggressively with a focus on tempo, using cards like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Murktide Regent to apply pressure on the opponent. The deck includes disruptive elements like Daze and Force of Will to protect your threats and ensure your opponent is unable to stabilize. The deck also includes card draw and manipulation with Brainstorm, Ponder, and Expressive Iteration to help you find your key cards. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive strategy, with Wasteland to disrupt your opponent's mana base and maximize your own tempo advantage.
